goal: Minimize reasoning dead time without paid API or always-on user PC while preserving disposable-worker semantics and single substantive authority.

layers.target_latency: predecessor END + 60s due plus measured scheduler jitter
layers.mechanism: Normal close mutates only this SAME MAIN recurring RRULE DTSTART to exact observed END+60 and live-verifies it.

layers.target_latency: next natural hourly recurrence after a lost shifted wake
layers.mechanism: The recurring RRULE remains enabled. A later occurrence reads fresh GitHub, classifies MAIN_COLD_FALLBACK_RECOVERY, and repairs forward without a replacement actor.
Optional future independent handoff research. It is not required for current correctness.

layers.activation: Explicit operator or durable emergency decision only after both SAME MAIN fast and natural recurring paths are diagnosed insufficient.

nonnegotiable_invariants: GitHub main is durable source of truth
duplicate wake never implies duplicate substantive side effect
same MAIN canonical remains enabled until program terminal or explicit operator stop
normal close requires live exact END+60 SAME MAIN verification
same MAIN recurring RRULE is the cold fallback
Watchdog is disabled standby and not a normal dependency

capability_evidence.rolling_rrule: Controlled +2m canary PASS plus production completion-relative automatic reentry; one scheduler-delay sample approximately 64s after due.
capability_evidence.epoch59_execution: 557 strict useful seconds over 626 wall seconds, showing in-turn execution improved enough for cross-turn latency to become the dominant measured constraint.
capability_evidence.p0_budget: 840/900 requires 93.33% useful coverage; a 600s turn permits about 42.9s average non-useful cross-turn loss.

current_blocker: Scheduled invocation can be recorded without durable BOOT_STARTED. MAIN v4 minimizes the bootstrap kernel and relies on its own recurring RRULE for cold recovery; collect observed delivery-to-bootstrap segments without inferring missing boundaries.
next_test: Complete epoch 74 under MAIN v4, verify exact END+60 close without Watchdog mutation, then observe whether the next shifted SAME MAIN writes BOOT_STARTED and REARM_VERIFIED.
